implementation: Readable portable C99 integer and decimal-digit algorithms; no CPU emulator or original firmware execution in implementation

implemented_routines.name: unsigned byte number constructor
implemented_routines.scope: All 256 byte inputs, including canonical zero

implemented_routines.name: copy ten-byte numeric record
implemented_routines.scope: Complete record copy; overlapping host buffers supported

implemented_routines.name: copy twenty-byte complex numeric record
implemented_routines.scope: Complete complex record copy; overlapping host buffers supported

implemented_routines.name: special-marker predicate
implemented_routines.scope: Exact first-low-nibble and last-byte-high-nibble checks

implemented_routines.name: decimal exponent extraction
implemented_routines.scope: Raw record exponent/sign behavior, including marker/error sentinel

implemented_routines.name: compact surd packing
implemented_routines.scope: Six normal integral components with nonnegative radicands and positive denominators; coefficient/denominator99 and radicand999 compact limits, scalar rational collapse and numeric fallback

implemented_routines.name: compact surd expansion
implemented_routines.scope: Both radical terms and exact canonical empty-first-term workspace

implemented_routines.name: rational construction
implemented_routines.scope: Integral numerator/denominator records; reduced mixed-record encoding and ten-nibble digit-budget decimal fallback

implemented_routines.name: decimal addition
implemented_routines.scope: Signed decimal inputs with optional header marker40, sixteen-digit alignment, exponent range errors

implemented_routines.name: decimal subtraction
implemented_routines.scope: Signed decimal inputs with optional header marker40, sixteen-digit alignment, exponent range errors

implemented_routines.name: decimal multiplication
implemented_routines.scope: Signed decimal inputs with optional header marker40, schoolbook decimal product, exponent range errors

implemented_routines.name: decimal division
implemented_routines.scope: Signed decimal inputs with optional header marker40, integer long division, exponent/divide-zero errors

implemented_routines.name: rational to decimal conversion
implemented_routines.scope: Decimal/error record copy and rational mixed-record conversion, including post-division low-mantissa cleanup

implemented_routines.name: surd to decimal conversion
implemented_routines.scope: Two signed radical terms; original square-root, coefficient multiplication, denominator division, then term addition order

implemented_routines.name: small low-mantissa residue cleanup
implemented_routines.scope: Plain and marked decimal records; nondecimal inputs unchanged

implemented_routines.name: fractional-digit predicate
implemented_routines.scope: Decimal records, including native exponent14 upper eligibility limit

implemented_routines.name: surd operand rational preprocessor
implemented_routines.scope: Unmarked decimal operand recognition through integer cleanup and continued-fraction interval search; exponent range-8..6 and ten-nibble result budget

implemented_routines.name: continued-fraction interval recognition
implemented_routines.scope: Portable integer interval recursion with decimal long division for scales above uint64_t; original forty-mantissa-unit radius

implemented_routines.name: square root
implemented_routines.scope: Decimal path including exponent-prefix remainder bias; Math-mode decimal fraction recognition, integral/rational bounded exact roots, square-factor normalization and native numeric fallbacks

implemented_routines.name: bounded radical square-factor normalization
implemented_routines.scope: Original candidate limit97, including coefficient/denominator reduction

implemented_routines.name: evaluator addition
implemented_routines.scope: Real decimal, rational and compact surd operands, exact two-term preservation and numeric fallback

implemented_routines.name: evaluator subtraction
implemented_routines.scope: Real decimal, rational and compact surd operands, exact two-term preservation and numeric fallback

implemented_routines.name: evaluator multiplication
implemented_routines.scope: Real decimal, rational and compact surd operands, bounded radical normalization and numeric fallback

implemented_routines.name: evaluator division
implemented_routines.scope: Real decimal, rational and compact surd operands; conjugate denominator construction and finite-component eligibility checks

implemented_routines.name: negate numeric record
implemented_routines.scope: Decimal, rational and compact surd sign-field behavior, including empty radical term signs

implemented_routines.name: finite decimal remainder and quotient
implemented_routines.scope: Unmarked decimal operands with nonzero divisor; fifteen-digit quotient workspace and native early stopping; negative divisor returns dividend/zero

implemented_routines.name: evaluator integer power fast paths
implemented_routines.scope: Real exponents-1,0,2,3 only; exact radical paths and header-marker clearing

gaps: Direct surd packing from nonintegral component records; special-marker quotient/remainder and error propagation outside validated inputs
General integer/noninteger powers, roots other than square root, logarithms, exponentials, trigonometric and hyperbolic functions
Complex arithmetic and conversion; combinatorics, random generation, base-N arithmetic
Statistical, matrix, vector, integration, differentiation, equation and numerical-solver subsystems
Routine-level global side effects and exhaustive numeric-state equivalence outside the exposed record API
completion: Partial subsystem implementation; full numeric firmware equivalence is not established
